**P2 — focused node remains mostly behind the sticky header.** [work-graph.tsx:224](/Users/rufus/.t3/worktrees/astack/t3-bfe8f653/apps/observatory/src/work-graph.tsx:224) derives the exposed top boundary from the SVG rectangle, which can extend underneath the [sticky header](/Users/rufus/.t3/worktrees/astack/t3-bfe8f653/packages/ui/src/styles.css:152).

Reproduction in Network Explorer at 1280×800:

1. Click **Zoom in** once.
2. Focus **Inspect Parent conversation**, press Enter.
3. From the inspector heading, press Shift+Tab 11 times.

The focused UI-checks conversation clears the inspector, but its circle spans **y=40.12–135.83**, while the header covers **y=0–120.18**. Its center hits the **Convex dashboard** navigation link via `elementFromPoint`. Only about 16px of the circle remains exposed. Reproduced twice. Zoom stays unchanged. The [new regression assertion](/Users/rufus/.t3/worktrees/astack/t3-bfe8f653/apps/observatory/e2e/storybook.e2e.ts:1988) checks SVG containment and inspector overlap, so it misses header occlusion.

Confirmed passes:

- Original fit-scale Shift+Tab reproduction: circle clears the inspector by 16px.
- Covered edge midpoint pans into exposed canvas; viewBox width/height remain unchanged.
- Inspection opening preserves the entire viewBox.
- Escape closes node and edge inspection and restores selected-target focus, including narrow layout.
- At 390×844, inspector stacks below the graph; node/edge focus causes no pan or horizontal overflow.
- Hidden selection shows “Its evidence remains…” while open, then “Show it again…” after closing; focus falls back to the graph.

Evidence used: targeted native keyboard interactions, DOM geometry/hit testing, rendered screenshots, source review, and inspection of the supplied focused report (**3/3 passed**, recorded at `8b7dd1c` with a dirty working tree). Browser: Headless Chrome **154.0.8037.92**, macOS, synthetic Storybook on port 6019. No console errors observed.

Remaining gaps: independent Pen comparison, screen reader/touch/other browsers, and parent-owned full-suite/local-Convex checks. Files, PR, capture and evaluation `c7391f59-36f1-40a0-8834-a280c2c2d50f` were untouched. Only my isolated preview tab was closed.
